faqs.question: Where can I download the official 2027–2028 Escambia County school calendar?
faqs.answer: The board-approved 2027–2028 PDF is available through the calendar link on this page and the district's School Calendars page. Check the district source for any later revisions.

faqs.question: When does summer break start in Escambia County in 2028?
faqs.answer: The final student day is Tuesday, May 23, 2028, a half day. Wednesday, May 24 is the first full day of summer break under the published calendar.

editorialSummary.heading: December 20 is a half day before Christmas Break
paragraphs: December 20, 2028, is a half day for Escambia County students, even though the Christmas Break caption in the academic calendar includes that date. Both the calendar grid and the district's revised work calendar confirm that students attend on December 20. Full days without regular classes begin December 21 and continue through January 3, followed by teacher planning days on January 4–5. Students return Monday, January 8, 2029.

The school year starts Thursday, August 10, 2028, and ends Wednesday, May 23, 2029, another half day. Fall Break covers Thanksgiving week, November 20–24. Spring Break runs March 26–30, with students scheduled to return Monday, April 2. The fourth nine weeks begins March 12, leaving two regular school weeks before Spring Break.

October 9, 2028, and February 19, 2029, are Professional Development Days with no classes for students. The October date falls before the first nine weeks ends on October 13. The district's board-approved calendar lists 178 student days and notes that break days may be used for make-up instruction if the schedule changes.

The two half days are December 20, 2028, and May 23, 2029. December 20 remains an attendance day despite the Christmas Break caption, and May 23 is the final student day. Confirm the 2028–2029 dismissal time and pickup arrangements with your school.
highlights: First day: August 10, 2028; last day: May 23, 2029.
December 20 is a half day; full days off begin December 21.
January 4–5 are teacher workdays; students return January 8.

about.dataSource: The district’s official 2028-2029 School Calendar PDF is the primary source. It prints Board Approved 2/18/25 and 178 total student days, with a Nine Weeks table and a color legend distinguishing student days, holidays, half days, professional development and teacher workdays. The revised 2028-2029 district work calendar, printed Revised 5/11/26, corroborates the December half day, Christmas Break, January teacher planning days and student return.
about.processing: The full one-page calendar was checked as text and as a rendered image, including the color legend and oval boundary markers. The local file matches the current official download by SHA-256. Pre-year and post-year teacher workdays and the post-year Memorial Day holiday are omitted because no regular-year student attendance is affected. Nine Weeks boundaries are milestones, not closures; coincident half-day and final-day meanings share one event. No semester, exam, report-card, senior endpoint or ceremony dates are inferred. The 205 weekdays between the published first and last student dates, less seven fixed no-class weekdays and 20 scheduled break weekdays, reconcile to 178. Each printed quarter count also agrees with its dated attendance schedule. The make-up footnote is applied conservatively to all three named break ranges without inventing priority or activation. Conditional break days are outside confirmed closure IDs; continuous planning spans include only weekends and supported no-class weekdays, with no guaranteed weekday-off count. The Christmas caption says December 20-January 3, but December 20 has the Half Day fill and ends Q2. The blue holiday fill starts December 21, establishing the derived full-day no-class start. Preserve the caption conflict without converting the December 20 half day into a closure. October 9 PD falls within Q1, and there is no April PD. The two separately marked January workdays are combined as a derived January 4-5 range. The revised work calendar independently confirms December 20 as a student half day, Christmas Break beginning December 21, January 4-5 as non-student teacher planning days, and January 8 as the student return. This corroboration does not remove the academic PDF caption conflict; the existing derived date basis and sourceDiscrepancies are retained.
about.updates: The district calendar page, all three linked PDFs, current announcements and available school notices were reviewed October 19, 2026. The PDFs say that break days may be used as make-up days and that statutory changes can require revisions. Recheck school messages when arranging travel or care. On October 21, 2026, the revised 2028-2029 district work calendar was checked as extracted text and a rendered page to corroborate the December-January attendance dates. The School Calendars page and its Graduation Dates link were also rechecked; the linked document is titled 2026-2027 High School Graduations.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference follows the district student calendar. Confirm school-specific hours, transportation, childcare, separate programs and any later attendance changes directly with your school.

faqs.question: When does school start in Escambia County, FL, in 2028?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Thursday, August 10, 2028. Teacher workdays before that date are not student attendance days.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Escambia County in 2029?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, May 23, 2029, is the last student day. It is a half day and marks the end of the fourth Nine Weeks period.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Escambia County schools in 2028?
faqs.answer: The district's Fall Break runs November 20–24, 2028, covering Thanksgiving week. Including both surrounding weekends, students are scheduled to be away from regular classes November 18–26. Classes resume Monday, November 27.

faqs.question: When is Christmas Break for Escambia County schools in 2028–2029?
faqs.answer: Students have no regular classes from December 21, 2028, through January 3, 2029. December 20 is a half day, even though the academic calendar's Christmas Break caption includes that date. January 4–5 are teacher planning days, and students return Monday, January 8. The district's revised work calendar confirms these dates.

faqs.question: Do Escambia County students have school on December 20, 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes. December 20 is a half day and the end of the second Nine Weeks period. Although the Christmas Break caption includes that date, the calendar marks it as a student attendance day. Full days off begin December 21 under the published schedule.

faqs.question: When do Escambia County students return from winter break in January 2029?
faqs.answer: Students return Monday, January 8, 2029. Christmas Break continues through January 3, followed by teacher workdays January 4–5 and the weekend.

faqs.question: When is Spring Break in Escambia County in 2029?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 26–30, 2029. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, April 2. The fourth nine weeks begins March 12, two weeks before the break.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays and professional-development days have no school in 2028–2029?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on October 9, 2028, and February 19, 2029, both Professional Development Days. January 4–5, 2029 are separate teacher planning days with no school for students.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day in Escambia County in 2028?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 4, 2028, is a teacher and student holiday.

faqs.question: Is there school on Columbus Day in Escambia County in 2028?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, October 9, 2028, is a Professional Development Day with no school for students. It falls within the first Nine Weeks period, which ends October 13. The district does not label October 9 a Columbus Day holiday.

faqs.question: Is there school on Veterans Day in Escambia County in 2028?
faqs.answer: No. The district observes Veterans Day on Friday, November 10, 2028, with no classes for students. November 11 falls on Saturday.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2029?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 15, 2029, is a teacher and student holiday.

faqs.question: Do Escambia County students have school on Presidents Day in 2029?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, February 19, 2029, is a Professional Development Day with no classes for students. The district does not label it a Presidents Day holiday.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday in Escambia County in 2029?
faqs.answer: No regular classes are scheduled on Friday, March 30, 2029, the final day of Spring Break. The district may use break days for make-up instruction if the calendar changes.

faqs.question: What are the half-day dates for Escambia County schools in 2028–2029?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, December 20, 2028, and Wednesday, May 23, 2029, are the two half days. Both are student attendance days.

faqs.question: What time do Escambia County schools dismiss on half days in 2028–2029?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists the half-day dates but does not specify dismissal times. Check your school's 2028–2029 bell schedule and transportation notices. Earlier school-year dismissal times should not be assumed to remain unchanged.

faqs.question: How many student days are in the 2028–2029 Escambia County school calendar?
faqs.answer: The board-approved calendar lists 178 student days. December 20 and May 23 are half days but still count as student attendance dates.

faqs.question: When do the nine-week grading periods end in 2028–2029?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 13, 2028; December 20, 2028; March 9, 2029; and May 23, 2029. December 20 and May 23 are half days. October 9 is a Professional Development Day but does not end the first grading period.

faqs.question: When will Escambia County report cards be available in 2028–2029?
faqs.answer: The annual school calendar gives the grading-period dates but does not list report-card release dates. Check your school and the FOCUS Parent Portal for grade and report-card updates.

faqs.question: Can Escambia County change the 2028–2029 school breaks to make up missed days?
faqs.answer: Yes. The board-approved calendar says break days may be used as make-up days and that the calendar can be revised. It does not specify which dates would be used or an order of priority. Check official district and school announcements before treating break plans as final.

faqs.question: Does the 2028–2029 calendar cover every school in Pensacola?
faqs.answer: This is the Escambia County Public Schools district student calendar. Independently operated charter schools, private schools, and separate college programs may follow different calendars. Confirm dates with the individual school or program.

faqs.question: Where can families find Escambia County high school graduation dates for 2029?
faqs.answer: The 2028–2029 academic calendar does not list individual graduation ceremonies, and a separate 2029 schedule has not been verified here. Check your high school's announcements for ceremony details rather than assuming graduation takes place on the last student day.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official Escambia County 2028–2029 school calendar?
faqs.answer: The board-approved 2028–2029 PDF is linked on this page and available through the district's School Calendars page. Check for revisions, particularly if you are planning around the December 20 half day and winter break.

faqs.question: When does summer break start in Escambia County in 2029?
faqs.answer: The school year ends with a half day on Wednesday, May 23, 2029. The first full day of summer break is Thursday, May 24. A 2029–2030 starting date has not been verified here.

sourceDiscrepancies.effect: The Christmas Break caption starts December 20, but that date is visibly a Half Day and the printed end of the second nine weeks. Blue holiday shading starts December 21. Retain December 20 as a half-day attendance date and derive December 21 as the full-day no-class start; do not add an extra closure or change the printed 178-day total.
